content: Apple bumped up prices on several of its devices in June, and we haven’t seen a good discount on the iPad Mini since. Just ahead of Amazon’s October Prime Big Deals Days, however, both Wi-Fi only and cellular-connected models are $100 off. The Wi-Fi version with 128GB of storage is currently $499, the 256GB model is $599, and the cellular model with 128GB of storage is $649. This base configuration of this tablet often sold for around $400 throughout 2025, so we get it if $500 for a tablet from late 2024 is still too much. But it’s the best price since late June, and if there’s a new version coming out later this year, it might be significantly more expensive. [Product: iPad Mini (2024) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3YF38G/?th=1&tag=theverge02-20, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3XZ1CH/?tag=theverge02-20, https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3XT3DX/?tag=theverge02-20] We reviewed this version of the iPad Mini when it launched in 2024, and while we appreciated the processor upgrade and Apple Intelligence features, it felt lacking in some of the quality-of-life improvements found in the larger iPads that launched around the same time. Read our Apple iPad Mini (2024) review.
chineseTitle: iPad Mini 在 Prime Day 期间再次稍微便宜一些

chineseContent: 苹果在 6 月份提高了几款设备的价格，此后我们就再也没有看到 iPad Mini 出现大幅折扣。然而，就在亚马逊 10 月 Prime 大优惠日之前，仅 Wi-Fi 和蜂窝网络连接的型号均可享受 100 美元的折扣。 128GB 存储的 Wi-Fi 版本目前售价 499 美元，256GB 型号为 599 美元，128GB 存储的蜂窝型号为 649 美元。这款平板电脑的基本配置在 2025 年全年的售价通常约为 400 美元，因此，如果 2024 年末的平板电脑售价 500 美元仍然太高，我们就买它。但这是自六月下旬以来的最佳价格，如果今年晚些时候有新版本推出，价格可能会贵很多。 [产品：iPad Mini (2024) | https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3YF38G/?th=1&tag=theverge02-20、https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3XZ1CH/?tag=theverge02-20、https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DK3XT3DX/?tag=theverge02-20] 我们在推出此版本的 iPad Mini 时对其进行了评测2024 年，虽然我们对处理器升级和 Apple Intelligence 功能表示赞赏，但感觉缺乏大约在同一时间推出的大型 iPad 所提供的一些生活质量改进。请阅读我们的 Apple iPad Mini (2024) 评测。
